definitions.explanation: The closed-fist hand shape in the game janken, which beats scissors (チョキ) and loses to paper (パー). Also refers to a clenched fist more generally.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧グー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}した→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
グー⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦チョキ→チョキ：29916_choki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}つ→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧グーにして、⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めた→込める：01945_komeru⟧。
examples.english: I made my hand into a fist and put strength into it.

notes:
One of the three hand shapes in ⟦じゃんけん→じゃんけん：06520_janken⟧ (rock-paper-scissors), together with ⟦チョキ→チョキ：29916_choki⟧ (scissors) and ⟦パー→パー：29917_paa⟧ (paper). グー is a closed fist; it beats ⟦チョキ→チョキ：29916_choki⟧ and loses to ⟦パー→パー：29917_paa⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- グー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to throw rock
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧グー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clench the hand into a fist
- ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧グー: "rock first" (the standard call that starts a game)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦チョキ→チョキ：29916_choki⟧: scissors — the two-finger shape
- ⟦パー→パー：29917_paa⟧: paper — the open-hand shape
